eas_text: A civil authority has issued A REQUIRED MONTHLY TEST for the following counties or areas: Florida; at 12:59 AM on AUG 21, 2013 Effective until 2:59 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is a required monthly test of the Florida Emergency Alert System from the State Emergency Operations Center in Tallahassee. Had this been an actual emergency, important information would have followed the alert tones. Atlantic hurricane season runs through November 30th. All Floridians should prepare a disaster supply kit, have a family emergency plan, and know whether they live in a hurricane evacuation zone. For more information, contact your county emergency management agency, or visit floridadisaster.org. This test is brought to you by the Florida Division of Emergency Management and the Florida Association of Broadcasters. This concludes the required monthly test.
